whatChanged.summary: Security audit and regression test pass. 5 code defects fixed. 1 new test file added (tests/security.test.ts) with 28 targeted regression tests.

filesModified.change: Replaced execSync with execFileSync (no shell). Added SAFE_GIT_REF regex validator for fromRef/toRef. Shell metacharacters in refs now return empty diff instead of executing.
Added cwd boundary check. Paths resolving outside process.cwd() throw Error('Path traversal rejected'). Check runs before dryRun shortcut.

Fixed vacuous-truth passed logic. replaced Object.values(verifications).every(Boolean) with explicit breakingCount===0 && !hasUnverifiedFindings. Empty verifications with BREAKING findings now correctly yields passed=false.
summarize() with empty changes[] no longer produces trailing colon. Now emits 'no changes' as detail string.
Removed false-positive drift: no longer diffs {} vs node.meta on digest mismatch. Now emits a single 'changed /digest' INFO finding instead of spurious 'all fields added' flood.
Removed unused SnapshotStore and detectRuntime imports.
Fixed .js extension on MCP SDK import paths to plain paths (CommonJS moduleResolution).

filesAdded.description: 28 targeted regression tests covering: shell injection, path traversal, vacuous-truth passed logic, empty-changes message format, scoreChanges edge cases, diffMeta array handling, parseOpenApi edge cases, parseZodSchema edge cases, verify step correctness, DriftReport.clean consistency.

findings.description: execSync with unvalidated fromRef/toRef interpolation. Attacker-controlled agent input could inject shell commands.
No path boundary check. sourcePath: '../../etc/passwd' would write to system files.
Snapshot drift detection diffed {} vs node.meta, generating spurious 'all fields added' findings on every non-fresh node.
Vacuous-truth: Object.values({}).every(Boolean)===true caused passed=true when BREAKING findings existed but verifications was empty {}.
summarize() with empty changes[] produced '[INFO] kind label: ' with trailing colon and empty string.
No tests for: shell injection, path traversal, empty changes, vacuous-truth passed, verify clean/broken, array diffing, edge-case YAML/Zod parsing.
SnapshotStore and detectRuntime imported but never used.
find_contract_consumers returns empty result with no warning when called before get_contract_graph (sharedGraph undefined). Acceptable for MVP — documented in AGENTS.md.
WATSONX_API_KEY checked at call time (not module load) — correct. No credentials hardcoded. IAM token not cached between calls (inefficient but safe).
Regex z.object(\{([\s\S]*?)\}) stops at first } — fails on nested z.object. For MVP scope (single-level schemas), acceptable. Documented.
@modelcontextprotocol/sdk imports used .js extension suffix — incompatible with moduleResolution:node.

details: create_release_approval: explicit BREAKING gate + hasUnverifiedFindings check
scorer summarize: 'no changes' fallback for empty parts
get_contract_graph: removed false-positive {} vs meta diff
